page.content:
Geartrude is a tourist who appears briefly in Paris in the film. She is seen waiting for the painter to finish her (idealized) portrait with her husband Lubewig, in front of the Sacré-Cœur Basilica.

page.overview:
Who is Geartrude?

Geartrude is a tourist who appears briefly in Paris in the film. She is seen waiting for the painter to finish her (idealized) portrait with her husband Lubewig, in front of the Sacré-Cœur Basilica.
